name: Aplisens S.A.
summary: Aplisens S.A. operates internationally and within Poland, specializing in the production and distribution of industrial process control equipment. Their core expertise lies in electronic technologies for measuring pressure and differential pressure. The company's diverse product portfolio includes pressure transmitters, pressure gauges, and HART communication devices; hydrostatic probes, transmitters, and switches for level measurement; temperature transmitters, sensors, and associated displays; electromagnetic and nozzle flow meters; and electro-pneumatic positioners along with APIS mounting kits. Additionally, they offer various diaphragm seals, such as flanged, chemical flanged, threaded, and sanitary types; a range of digital, linear, and multi-channel indicators, displays, and data loggers; valve manifolds and essential fitting accessories; and electronic components like power supplies, signal isolators/converters, and overvoltage protection circuits. For the automotive sector, Aplisens also develops specialized items including fuel level probes, fuel filler security products, fuel and pulse converters, RFID rotation detectors, electronic seals, and RFID tank door sensors for fuel filler flaps. Established in 1992, Aplisens S.A. maintains its headquarters in Warsaw, Poland.
